data.name: Chayani
data.gender_notes: Chayani is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chaya', meaning shadow or reflection. In Hindu mythology, Chayani is the goddess of prosperity, abundance, and nourishment. She is often depicted as a goddess of the earth and is believed to provide sustenance and protection to her devotees. The name Chayani carries the meaning “Goddess of prosperity and abundance” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chayani usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and abundance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine feminine energy and the abundance of nature's blessings.
data.etymology: Chayani belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of prosperity and abundance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chayani total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_sanskrit.name: चयनि
in_sanskrit.meaning: चयन (choice) + ई (I) = चयनी (one who is chosen)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Chayani is derived from the Sanskrit word 'चयन' which means 'choice'. The suffix 'ई' (I) is added to it to make the name feminine. Thus, Chayani means 'one who is chosen'.

data.cultural_impact: The name Chayani carries a rich cultural heritage, connecting the bearer to the ancient Indian tradition. In Hindu society, Chayani represents the bedrock of stability and growth, similar to the shadow that follows an object, providing constant support and companionship.
data.spiritual_significance: Chayani embodies the spiritual qualities of prosperity, abundance, and nourishment. She represents the divine mother who provides for her children, just as the earth nourishes all living beings. Additionally, the name enhances one's connection to the divine feminine, emphasizing the importance of compassion, love, and protection.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Chayani means 'the embodiment of grace and beauty.' It is believed that this name bestows upon the bearer an aura of elegance and charm, attracting positivity and good fortune.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Chayani was a princess in the Mahabharata. The name Chayani carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
